transcript.statement: The requirements I propose focus on ensuring the safety and reliability of the ATM system. SAF-01 prevents negative balances, safeguarding users from financial risk. SAF-04 logs transactions for accountability and traceability, crucial for safety. SAF-05 secures user authentication via PIN, protecting against unauthorized access. SAF-06 allows limited withdrawals during maintenance, ensuring safe degradation. SAF-07 provides users with clear account summaries, enhancing transparency. Conflicts arise with RES-03 and TRU-04, which also prevent negative balances but may not address the comprehensive safety measures I propose.

transcript.statement: The requirements I propose focus on optimizing the performance efficiency of the ATM system. EFF-05 ensures automatic fund withdrawal without user delay, improving transaction speed. EFF-06 provides immediate feedback on withdrawal requests, enhancing user experience. EFF-07 implements load balancing to manage requests effectively. transcript.statement: The requirements I propose focus on enhancing the sustainability of the ATM system. requirements.text: The ATM system shall ensure that no account can have a negative balance.
The ATM system shall automatically withdraw funds from the related saving account if the checking account balance is insufficient.
The ATM system shall inform the user and terminate the transaction if the saving account balance is insufficient for the withdrawal.
The ATM system shall log all transactions with date, time, type, amount, and resulting balance, ensuring accountability and security.
The system shall implement secure PIN verification for user authentication.
The ATM system shall provide users with a clear summary of account status after each transaction.
The ATM system shall process transactions within 3 seconds while incorporating energy efficiency metrics.
The ATM system shall maintain a transaction throughput of at least 100 transactions per minute while considering energy consumption.
The ATM system shall optimize data retrieval to minimize latency while ensuring energy efficiency.
The system shall provide a mechanism for safe degradation by allowing limited withdrawals during system maintenance.
The ATM system shall ensure all transactions comply with applicable financial regulations and standards.
The ATM system shall maintain user privacy by securely encrypting all personal and financial data.
